issues.t: Death wobble front-end shake
issues.sym: After a bump at highway speed, the steering wheel and front end shake violently and keep shaking until you slow way down.
issues.why: Like the Wrangler, the Gladiator uses a solid front axle that depends on tight steering and suspension joints. Loose track bar bolts or worn track bar, tie rod, drag link or ball joint parts can start a runaway shake. A worn steering damper can hide the problem but does not cause it.
issues.next: Slow down steadily without jerking the wheel. Have the track bar bolts torqued and the track bar, tie rods, drag link and ball joints inspected and replaced as needed, then balance and align the tires.

issues.t: Wandering, loose steering at highway speeds (TSB)
issues.sym: The truck drifts left or right and needs constant small corrections to stay in its lane, with play or a dead spot at center. Wind and trailers make it worse.
issues.why: Wandering is the top 2020 Gladiator complaint, often in the first few thousand miles. Jeep's bulletin 08-074-20 covers replacing the steering gear and updating the electric-hydraulic power steering software.
issues.next: Have the alignment checked and ask the dealer about bulletin 08-074-20. If the steering still feels loose afterward, go back, since some owners needed further work.

issues.t: Misfire and ticking from worn rocker arms or camshaft
issues.sym: A check engine light (sometimes flashing) with misfire codes, rough running, loss of power on hills, and a ticking noise that gets worse over time.
issues.why: On the 3.6L V6, a rocker arm roller can fail and wear a groove into a camshaft lobe, and lifters can go soft. Misfires from these and from worn plugs or coils are the second most common 2020 Gladiator complaint.
issues.next: Have the misfire diagnosed beyond plugs and coils, including a check of the rockers and cam lobes. If the valvetrain is worn, the rockers and camshaft are normally replaced together. Ask about powertrain warranty coverage.

issues.t: Check engine light from torque converter clutch code (TSB)
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P1DB7. The automatic may run hot, and you may see a transmission temperature warning on long climbs or while towing.
issues.why: On 2022 and 2023 automatic V6 trucks, the transmission computer's software can mismanage the torque converter clutch, the part that locks the engine to the transmission at cruising speed. Jeep bulletins 21-023-25 (2022) and 21-019-25 (2023) cover a software fix.
issues.next: Have the code read. If it is P1DB7, ask the dealer for the transmission computer update in the bulletin for your year. If the transmission temperature warning comes on, ease off and let it cool, and do not keep towing until it is checked.

issues.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensor heater codes (TSB)
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on, usually with no change in how the truck drives. A scan shows oxygen sensor heater codes such as P0032, P0038, P0052 or P0058.
issues.why: Engine computer software on some 2024 V6 trucks can wrongly flag the oxygen sensor heaters. Jeep bulletin 18-065-24 updates the software; if the codes return, a sensor may truly need replacing.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer about bulletin 18-065-24. If the light comes back after the update, have the sensor and its wiring tested before replacing parts.

issues.t: Manual clutch can overheat and break (recalls)
issues.sym: A clutch temperature warning, a burning smell or smoke after slow off-road or stop-and-go driving, a soft pedal, or slipping and hard shifting.
issues.why: The clutch pressure plate can overheat and crack, which can throw debris, start a fire or leave you without drive. Early recalls rerouted wiring and added software; recall 23V-116 replaces the clutch assembly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 20V-124, 21V-028 and 23V-116. If you see the warning or smell burning, stop and let the clutch cool, and avoid long clutch slipping until it is repaired.

issues.t: Engine software may stall manual trucks (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls and you lose drive power.
issues.why: Engine computer software on some 2021 manual-transmission trucks could stall the engine, including trucks already updated under the clutch recall.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Check your VIN for recall 24V-572. The dealer updates the software free.

issues.t: No backup camera or reverse lights on manual trucks (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera picture does not appear and the reverse lights stay off when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A faulty gear position sensor on the manual transmission may not report that reverse is selected.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V-641. The dealer replaces the sensor free.

issues.t: EcoDiesel high-pressure fuel pump failure (recalls)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of power or a stall while driving, long cranking or no-start, and fuel pressure warning codes.
issues.why: The high-pressure fuel pump can wear internally and fail, sending metal debris through the fuel system and stalling the engine.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 22V-767 and 23V-263. If the engine stalls or loses power, get off the road and have the truck towed rather than restarting it repeatedly.

issues.t: Instrument cluster can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The gauge cluster goes dark or flickers, gauges stop working, all warning lights come on at once, or turn signal indicators stop showing.
issues.why: The instrument cluster can short internally and fail.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: you may not see your speed or warning lights, so ease off, keep a safe distance, and pull over where it's safe. Restarting the car once parked may bring the display back; if it doesn't, have it fixed before you drive again. Check your VIN for recall 24V-652. The dealer replaces the cluster free.

issues.t: Power steering pump wiring fire risk (recall)
issues.sym: A burning or electrical smell from the front of the engine bay, a power steering warning, or steering assist that comes and goes.
issues.why: The wiring to the electric-hydraulic power steering pump can overheat at its connection and start a fire, even with the truck parked and off.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for recall 26V-363. Park outside and away from buildings until the dealer replaces the wiring and pump as needed.

issues.t: Rear driveshaft joint built without grease (recall)
issues.sym: A vibration at 45-70 mph that gets worse over time. In the worst case the driveshaft breaks.
issues.why: The joint at one end of the rear driveshaft on some early trucks was assembled without grease, so it can overheat, seize or fracture.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 19V-636. The dealer replaces the driveshaft free. If it breaks, set the parking brake before leaving the truck.

issues.t: Front seat belt may not hold in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms.
issues.why: A front seat belt retractor might not control the occupant's forward movement after it locks in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-580. The dealer replaces the retractors free.

issues.t: Backup camera image stays on after reverse (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture stays on the screen after you shift out of reverse.
issues.why: A radio software error kept the image on longer than federal rules allow.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-191. The update is free at a dealer or over the air.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank or does not show the rear camera picture when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A radio software error could stop the rearview image from displaying.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-638. The dealer updates the radio software free.

issues.t: Automatic may not hold in Park (recall)
issues.sym: The truck can roll after you shift into Park.
issues.why: The parking pawl inside the automatic transmission might not engage properly.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and check your VIN for recall 22V-639. The dealer replaces the transmission free.

issues.t: Seat belt pretensioner may not fire (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning; an airbag light may come on.
issues.why: The gas generator in the front seat belt retractors may have been welded improperly, so the pretensioner may not work in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-766. The dealer replaces the retractors free.

issues.t: Driver airbag may not deploy from steering column module (recall)
issues.sym: An airbag warning light may come on, or there may be no warning.
issues.why: The steering column control module, which connects the driver airbag, may have been welded improperly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-199. The dealer inspects and replaces the module free.

issues.t: Steel wheels can crack (recall)
issues.sym: A vibration, a tire that will not hold air, or visible cracks in a steel wheel.
issues.why: Some steel wheels were made with walls that are too thin and can crack or come off.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-456 right away and do not drive on a cracked wheel.

issues.t: Backup camera image may fail in reverse (2026 recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture does not show when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A radio software problem can keep the rearview image from displaying.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-531. The fix is a free dealer or over-the-air software update.

issues.t: Rubicon sway bar disconnect stops working
issues.sym: The sway bar disconnect light flashes and the front sway bar will not disconnect or reconnect.
issues.why: Water and mud can corrode the electric actuator and its connector, and the bar can bind when it is under load. Owners filed a class action over failures.
issues.next: Park on level ground and try again so the bar is not loaded. If it still fails, have the actuator and connector checked.

issues.t: Tire pressure warning light on with tires properly filled (TSB)
issues.sym: The tire pressure warning light stays on or flashes even though all four tires are at the right pressure.
issues.why: Jeep issued bulletin S2408000002 in January 2024 for 2024 Gladiators with a steady or flashing tire pressure light, pointing to a known fault in the tire pressure monitoring system rather than the tires.
issues.next: First check every tire, including the spare, with a gauge, since a real low tire is a safety risk. If pressures are correct and the light stays on, ask the dealer about bulletin S2408000002.

issues.t: Uconnect screen glitches and "Uconnect Box Error" (TSBs)
issues.sym: The 12.3-inch touchscreen acts up: ghost touches, a black navigation map, missing widgets, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto dropping out, or a message that the Uconnect Box needs service.
issues.why: These are software faults in the Uconnect 5 radio and the telematics module on refreshed trucks. Jeep released several updates, including bulletins 08-033-25 (USB update for 2024), 08-131-25 (over-the-air radio update for 2024-2025) and 08-269-25 (telematics update for 2025).
issues.next: Accept any over-the-air update the screen offers, with the truck in Park and the engine off. If problems remain, ask the dealer to check your software level against these bulletins.

issues.t: Rear window defroster stops working (TSB)
issues.sym: The rear window does not clear when you press the rear defrost button, or only part of it clears.
issues.why: Jeep bulletin S2523000024 for the 2025 Gladiator covers the solder connections on the rear glass defroster grid coming loose from the glass.
issues.next: Look at the two connection points on the edges of the rear glass for a loose tab. If the truck is under warranty, have the dealer repair it under this bulletin rather than gluing it yourself.
